dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped structures are concentrated on the posterior dorsal region. These exhibit sharp gradients from dark exterior perimeters to lighter interior cores. A prominent closed 'O' structure is visible near the posterior-most dorsal curve, and several interlocking 'C' shapes are located mid-posteriorly.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low spatial density of isolated, solid high-intensity white pixel clusters. Three distinct punctate blobs are visible on the mid-lateral flank, positioned in an approximate triangular arrangement. These clusters show uniform high pixel values without internal gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three prominent mid-flank blobs form an obtuse triangle. The centroids of the posterior macro-annuli form a dense, irregular polygonal cluster.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Three small, dark, circular low-intensity focal points are visible in a near-vertical alignment on the mid-lateral flank. A distinct cutaneous fold is visible near the anterior-inferior boundary.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive dendritic or web-like network of high-intensity lines spanning the superior dorsal ridge, forming a continuous reticulated pattern distinct from the isolated annuli.
